text: Civil Engineering is a discipline with "construction" as its core, aiming to achieve the planning, design, construction and maintenance of various types of infrastructure through scientific principles and engineering technologies. From high-rise buildings, Bridges and tunnels to highways, railways, water conservancy and hydropower, civil engineering covers almost all physical space construction fields necessary for human survival and development. This major integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as mathematics, mechanics, materials science, and computer technology, emphasizing the combination of theory and practice. It aims to cultivate compound talents with capabilities in engineering investigation, structural design, construction management, and project operation, in order to address the construction demands in fields such as urbanization, transportation networks, energy, and water conservancy.
